ideas.pitch: A dual-mode electric hovercraft featuring real-time LiDAR and OpenCV-based lane keeping to maximize points in the racing round.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovermania Racing Rounds: navigating an obstacle track autonomously for bonus points.
ideas.title: AeroGuard: Autonomous Obstacle-Avoidance Hovercraft
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the autonomy bonus points explicitly gives this entry a massive mathematical advantage over manual-steering competitors, leveraging the edge-AI robotics patterns seen in past winners.

ideas.pitch: A reinforced-skirt, high-torque electric hovercraft optimized for stability and lateral pushing force during knockout arena battles.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovermania Knockout Rounds: pushing opponents off the arena while avoiding inactivity penalties.
ideas.title: RamBot: Push-Tactics Combat Hovercraft
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses purely on the physical mechanics and center-of-gravity tuning needed to survive the aggressive knockout stage, standing out through robust hardware engineering.

ideas.pitch: An aerodynamic hovercraft equipped with IMU-based dead reckoning and optical flow sensors for rapid checkpoint traversal.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovermania Racing Rounds: scoring points based on successful track navigation, obstacle avoidance, and minimum time taken.
ideas.title: ApexHover: Hybrid Speed-Tuned Autonomous Racer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the scoring formula (Total Points minus Time Taken) by combining high-speed manual control with high-precision autonomous checkpoint snapping.

ideas.pitch: A microcontroller-based thrust-vectoring unit that dynamically balances lift height and forward momentum to prevent drift penalties.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovermania Rules: maintaining a minimum lift height of 3 cm while avoiding penalties for deviating from the path.
ideas.title: VectorLift: Dynamic Lift and Thrust Control System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific compliance and stability constraints of the competition rules, ensuring zero penalty points from lift failure or path deviation.

ideas.pitch: A compact onboard camera and processing unit that detects rival hovercrafts and automatically triggers counter-thrust vectors.
ideas.problem_statement: Hovermania Knockout Rounds: fighting in elimination rounds and avoiding inactivity penalties.
ideas.title: SentinelAI: Edge-Powered Knockout Target Lock
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings smart automation into the combat phase, completely eliminating inactivity penalties by using computer vision to track and engage opponents automatically.
